name: form-request
description: A centered request/contact form card with a richtext header (title plus subtitle) and repeatable field items (label, placeholder, type) that render as text, half-width, email, textarea, consent checkbox, or submit controls in a responsive two-column field grid.

contentPattern.structure: Row 0 is the header (title + subtitle); each following field item supplies label, placeholder, and a type select that drives input rendering, with consent and submit as special types; no image
